integrity_note: Combinatorial proof for all graph orders and standalone finite exact checks. OEIS scalar prior acknowledged. All four literature-comparison checks have residual priority limits; independent external review was not performed.
scientific_limitations: The identity holds only for ordinary \(P_3\)-convex vertex subsets of labelled simple sunlet graphs of cycle length at least three. It does not concern induced-\(P_3\) convexity, arbitrary corona graphs, or symmetry-orbit counts. Scalar counts and recurrence are previously documented as OEIS A073313; historical priority of the new bivariate refinement is provisional.
title: Complete core–leaf profile of ordinary \(P_3\)-convex sets in sunlet graphs
